items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This template engine vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction, potentially gaining elevated access or control over user accounts. Adobe released APSB26-153 to address this flaw, but new installations may remain vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical, high, and medium severity issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system writes, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, but it includes a fix for CVE-2026-103849.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (PolyShell)
items.summary: This unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, also known as PolyShell, can lead to arbitrary code execution. CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026, confirming active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: Dubbed 'StyleSmuggler,' this maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was actively exploited as a zero-day before Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146). Attackers inject malicious PHP code through the template engine's `styles` property.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (CVE-2026-75650 Hotfix)
items.summary: This out-of-band security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe confirmed that CVE-2026-75650 was being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple Cross-site Scripting (XSS) and Incorrect Authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications emerged that threat actors were attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild shortly after its disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce B2B allows unauthenticated code execution. It was addressed as part of APSB26-153.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability is associated with privilege escalation and was addressed in APSB26-153.
